analysis_model.critical_boundary: A V_T,50 is reportable only if the locked 120-run parent snapshot passes hash and quality checks, all 30 round-2 runs are valid and complete, at least two distinct velocities per cell have 1–9 events, observed fractions do not decrease, and the pooled ordinary grouped-logistic fit is finite with positive slope and V_T,50 inside the tested velocity span. Failure preserves not_ready. No automatic further velocity selection is permitted.
analysis_model.name: grouped binomial logistic regression using all pooled P2-F, round-1, and round-2 velocity groups

excluded_estimable_cell.reason: R1L0 is already estimated from the locked 20/21/22 km/s pooled data and is deliberately not rerun in round 2.

factor_cells.rationale: The pooled observations 20 km/s: 1/10, 21 km/s: 10/10, 22 km/s: 10/10 contain only one non-extreme group. 20.5 km/s is the preregistered midpoint for a second mixed group.
The pooled observations 20 km/s: 0/10, 21 km/s: 3/10, 22 km/s: 10/10 contain only one non-extreme group. 21.5 km/s is the preregistered midpoint for a second mixed group.
The pooled observations 21 km/s: 0/10, 22 km/s: 6/10, 24 km/s: 10/10 contain only one non-extreme group. 21.5 km/s is the preregistered midpoint for a second mixed group.

primary_endpoint.definition: At the terminal snapshot after the pre-registered approach run plus 5.0 ps NVE recovery, count original projectile atoms (LAMMPS type 4) with z <= -500 Angstrom and divide by the initial projectile atom count.
primary_endpoint.event_definition: A binary event is recorded only when the terminal projectile-origin downstream mass fraction is greater than or equal to 0.50.
primary_endpoint.name: terminal_projectile_origin_downstream_mass_fraction
primary_endpoint.prohibited_name: Do not call this conventional ballistic V50 or an intact-projectile perforation threshold.
primary_endpoint.reporting_name: V_T,50: velocity at which the probability of the pre-registered >=50% projectile-origin downstream mass-transmission event is 0.5.

protocol.purpose: Second pre-registered P2-F resolution stage. It adds one velocity group only to the three cells whose pooled parent-plus-round1 ordinary grouped-logistic likelihood remains unbounded. R1L0 is excluded because its threshold is already estimable and must not be rerun.
